speaker: charlie
text: Now for the science desk, and researchers here in Queensland are chipping away at something pretty special, coral that can cope with hotter water without bleaching out. Its early days but the labs are buzzing about the potential for the reef long term.

speaker: alice
text: Its the kind of slow and steady science that doesnt always make headlines but could genuinely change the game for the Great Barrier Reef. Every bit of heat tolerance they can breed in gives the reef a bit more breathing room.

speaker: charlie
text: Exactly, its not a silver bullet, but its a solid step in the right direction. Good on the boffins for sticking with it.
